headline: Japan Investment Corp Plans Sale of JSR to Mitsui Chemicals
summary: The Japan Investment Corp (JIC) is reportedly planning to sell its stake in JSR Corporation to Mitsui Chemicals. The deal would consolidate assets within the Japanese chemical and semiconductor materials sector.
why: JSR is a key supplier of photoresists used in semiconductor manufacturing. Consolidation in this sector is closely watched by global tech investors due to the critical nature of the supply chain.
